import itertools, collections
def load():
    import os,re
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

def parse_demo(k):
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {k} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {k} output']
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])

    bc=[c for c in range(W) if sum(1 for r in range(H) if gi[r][c]==8)>W*0.2]
    # orientation: majority structure; if bar rows have more 8s than bar cols -> horizontal bars

    return 'vert' if len(bc)>=len(br) else 'horiz'

import os,re,json,glob
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])+'/../../sessions/'
def load():
    allrows=[]; headers=set()
    for f in glob.glob(d+'*.jsonl')+glob.glob(d+'**/*.jsonl',recursive=True):
        t=open(f,encoding='utf8').read().replace('\\n','\n'); n=len(t); pos=[m.start() for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t)]
        if not pos: continue
        # take first valid header occurrence
        best=min(pos)
        h_,w_=map(int,re.match(r'Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input \((\d+)x(\d+)\)', t[best]))
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[best+1:n].split('\n')[:int(h_)]]
        if rows and len(rows)==int(h_):
            allrows.append((t[best:h],[(int(x) for x in r) for r in rows],h_,w_))
    return allrows

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
base=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
def load():
    G={}
    for p in sorted(glob.glob(base+'/../../sessions/*.jsonl')):
        t=open(p, errors='ignore').read().replace('\\n','\n')
        for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
            k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
            rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
            if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
                G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(v for r in g for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[[bg]*W]+[list(g[r]) for r in range(H-1)]
    # seed cells of minority color (here 2) paint 8 down their column
    from collections import Counter as C
    cnt=C(v for r in g for v in r)
    minority=[c for c,n in cnt.items() if n==min(cnt.values())]
    for (r,c) in [(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==min(minority)[0]]:
        for i in range(r+1,H): out[i][c]=8
    return out
print('demo7', f(G['Demo pair 7 input'])==G['Demo pair 7 output'], f(G['Demo pair 8 input'])==G['Demo pair 8 output'])
print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))

for i in [1,2,3]:
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {i} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {i} output']
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    print('=== pair',i)
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if gi[r][c]!=0: continue
            col8=[rr for rr in range(H) if rr<r and gi[rr][c]==8]
            cb8=[rr for rr in range(H) if rr>r and gi[rr][c]==8]
            rl8=[cc for cc in range(c) if gi[r][cc]==8]
            cr8=[cc for cc in range(c+1,W) if gi[r][cc]==8]
            s=[(rr,cc) for rr in range(H) for cc in range(W) if gi[rr][cc]==2][:1]
            sr,sc=s[0]
            d=max(abs(r-sr),abs(c-sc)), abs(r-sr)+abs(c-sc)
            label='T' if go[r][c]==2 else '.'
            print(f'{label} ({r},{c}) | above_n={len(col8)} below_n={len(cb8)} left_n={len(rl8)} right_n={len(cr8)} dist_cheb={d[0]} dist_man={d[1]}')
        if all(go[r][c]!=2 for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if gi[r][c]==0):
            break

def solve(g,minsize=8):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    objs=comps(g,minsize)
    bgc=Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    changed_cells=[]
    # assign: noise cell -> color of nearest object (Manhattan); ties -> fallback to most common object color at same distance; if none nearby -> background
    dists=defaultdict(list)
    for col_,cells in objs:
        for a,b in cells:
            for r in range(H):
                for c in range(W):
                    d=abs(r-a)+abs(c-b)
                    dists[(r,c,d)].append(col_)
    objcols=defaultdict(int)
    tot=defaultdict(int)
    for col_,cells in objs:
        objcols[col_]+=len(cells)
    cnt=Counter(col for row in g for col in row)
    globalbg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            best=None
            for d in range(3,20):
                cands=dists.get((r,c,d),[])
                if cands: break
                pass
            cand=[]
            for d,col_ in [(abs(r-a)+abs(c-b),col_) for col_,cells in objs for a,b in cells]:
                cand.append((d,col_))
            if not cand: continue
            cand.sort()
            d0,col_=cand[0]
            bests=[x for x in cand if x[0]==d0]
            if len(bests)==1: out[r][c]=bests[0][1]; changed_cells.append((r,c,g[r][c],out[r][c]))
            elif len(set(bests[1]))==1: out[r][c]=bests[0][1]
            else: out[r][c]=globalbg
    return out
for i in range(1,9):

    pred=solve(gi)
    mism=sum(pred[r][c]!=go[r][c] for r in range(len(go)) for c in range(len(go[0])))
